(async () => { await MM.app.testing.loadFromUrl('http://127.0.0.1:8137/.test/photo5.jpg'); await MM.app.testing.runAuto(); const m = JSON.parse(MM.app.testing.dump()).measurements; const crown = { x: m.points.crown.x / m.imageW, y: m.points.crown.y / m.imageH }; const widthHead = m.headPxFromWidth / m.imageH; window.__auto = { crown, chinHuman: { x: crown.x, y: crown.y + widthHead }, chinFit: { x: m.points.chin.x / m.imageW, y: m.points.chin.y / m.imageH }, feet: { x: m.points.feet[0].x / m.imageW, y: m.points.footY / m.imageH }, imgW: m.imageW, imgH: m.imageH }; return 'state ' + MM.app.testing.state().phase; })()

(() => { MM.app.testing.enterManual(); const el = document.getElementById('overlay'); el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const fire = (type, n, extra) => el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, Object.assign({ bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'touch', isPrimary: true, clientX: rect.left + n.x * rect.width, clientY: rect.top + n.y * rect.height }, extra || {}))); const A = window.__auto; for (const p of [A.crown, A.chinFit, A.feet]) { fire('pointerdown', p); fire('pointerup', p); } MM.app.testing.manualCalc(); document.getElementById('manualBar').scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); return MM.app.testing.state().phase; })()

(() => { const A = window.__auto; MM.app.testing.setManualPoints([A.crown, A.chinHuman, A.feet]); const el = document.getElementById('overlay'); const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const n = MM.manual.points()[1]; el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 3, pointerType: 'touch', isPrimary: true, clientX: rect.left + n.x * rect.width, clientY: rect.top + n.y * rect.height })); const l = document.getElementById('loupe'); return JSON.stringify({ loupeVisible: getComputedStyle(l).display !== 'none' }); })()

(() => { MM.manual.isActive() && document.getElementById('overlay').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 3, pointerType: 'touch', isPrimary: true })); MM.app.testing.manualCalc(); return MM.app.testing.state().phase + ' ' + MM.app.testing.state().estimate.cm; })()

(() => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 600; c.height = 900; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.fillStyle = '#8a8f96'; g.fillRect(0, 0, 600, 900); window.__grayUrl = c.toDataURL('image/png'); return 'gray'; })()

(async () => { await MM.app.testing.loadFromUrl(window.__grayUrl, 'gray.png'); await MM.app.testing.runAuto(); document.getElementById('errorCard').scrollIntoView({ block: 'start', behavior: 'instant' }); return MM.app.testing.state().phase; })()
